about: Modwerk source-only track-names package for Digitakt II OS 1.17, compiled from sdk/digitakt-ii/modules/track-names.

mods.title: Track Names
mods.summary: The Internal Mixer shows each track's own name instead of TRK1..TRK16, with the track number above every fader.
mods.description: The Internal Mixer shows the first 5 characters of each track's name from SETUP > RENAME instead of TRK1..TRK16, and the track number in an inverted box above every fader. Names are per pattern and saved with the project by the OS; the mod only draws.
mods.author: crisp909
mods.on_unit: The author ran this exact package on a Digitakt II, OS 1.17, core 1.0 (2026-11-13, about 2 hours with 0.1.2): names on mixer pages 2/5 and 3/5, per pattern with PERFORM KIT off, kept after SAVE PROJECT and a reload, other pages unchanged, pop-ups on top.
